tasks.CalculateArea: Compute the area of the set S using integration or other suitable methods.
tasks.DefineSetS: Determine the set S of points (a,b) with 0 ≤ a, b ≤ 1 such that the equation x^4 + ax^3 - bx^2 + ax + 1 = 0 has at least one real root.
tasks.FindRealRoots: Analyze the polynomial to find conditions on a and b for which it has real roots.
